dos.text: Listen for "scroll" on the moz-box-group host itself, since #forwardScroll re-dispatches internal shadow-tree scroll events as a composed Event on the host specifically so listeners like a panel-list's hide-on-scroll can see them.

Only use moz-box-item children when type="reorderable-list", the JSDoc and the itemselector ("moz-box-item:not([static])") passed to moz-reorderable-list both restrict dragging to that element, so moz-box-link/moz-box-button children won't become draggable.

donts.text: Don't manually set a slot attribute on children inside a type="list" or "reorderable-list" group, updated() overwrites item.slot to a numeric index (or `static-${i}`) for every list/static item on every re-render.
